proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5071 *chōṭṭa gives regional choṭā/choṭo small. The selected aspirated choṭa adjective specifies the younger sibling. The second component is brother (CDIAL 9661 bhrātṛ, regional bhāi/bhāū/bhrā). Two ordered etymological component links preserve the complete response; they do not assert one inherited Sanskrit compound or resolve internal Indo-Aryan transmission. Exact response: cʰoṭā bāy.
